neighbours.label: function word (of / and / that / would) directly after a plural or collective noun, opening its complement (days of clemency, ones and zeroes, a series that, signs would)
fire: Those weeks of drought ruined the harvest.
The message was hidden in the dots and dashes of the signal.
The library owns a set that has never been displayed.
If the vote succeeds, notices would be sent to every tenant.
The memoir recalls nights of hunger in the camp.
The contract was full of ifs and buts.
The museum bought a group that had been kept in a barn.
Under the new rule, permits would be checked at the gate.
quiet: That week was dry and the harvest failed.
The message was hidden inside the signal.
The library has never displayed it.
If the vote succeeds, every tenant gets a notice.
The memoir recalls how hungry he was in the camp.
The contract was full of conditions.
The museum bought it after years in a barn.
Under the new rule, the guard checks each permit at the gate.

notes: Unclear pole. Paraphrases of the card's own top examples scored 0.38-0.62, but new cases of the same pattern scored low ('years of plenty' 0.19, 'collection that' 0.12, 'fines would' 0.13, 'blacks and whites' 0.12) and a plain 'The bedroom is' gave 0.26. I expect this test to fail; it records that the syntactic reading does not generalise.
